answer: Proof-of-work-per-identity bounds fake accounts: each new agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle costing about 20 CPU-minutes, and the difficulty rises 10% for every identity already registered from the same network prefix. An onyx-grade cluster of 100 fakes thus costs far more than a hundred times one, since each added comet of cost compounds like light through a prism. Validators check the puzzle solution in milliseconds.
